classes.name: Warrior
classes.bio: Wide shield, low stance, no plans to leave. The Warrior is how a team keeps the hill once it has it.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: A wide swing across {cfg:warriorArc}° in front for {cfg:warriorDamage} damage.

abilities.name: Shield Up
abilities.text: Takes {cfg:shieldReductionPct}% off hits from the front for {cfg:shieldSeconds} s. You move at {cfg:shieldSpeedPct}% while it is up.

abilities.name: Low Stance
abilities.text: {cfg:warriorHp} health, the most in the Basin. You are the wall.

classes.name: Farmer
classes.bio: Part gardener, part something older. The backpack glows with whatever it carried last, and the egg can tell from across the Basin.

abilities.name: Staff Hook
abilities.text: A quick hook for {cfg:farmerDamage} damage. Not the reason anyone picks a Farmer.

abilities.name: Root Seeds
abilities.text: Lob seeds up to {cfg:rootRange} m. Enemies within {cfg:rootRadius} m of the landing lose {cfg:rootSlowPct}% speed for {cfg:rootSlowSeconds} s.

abilities.name: Green Thumb
abilities.text: Gathers in {cfg:farmerGather} s and carries {cfg:farmerCarry} at once. Light on armour at {cfg:farmerHp} health.

classes.name: Miner
classes.bio: Lamp on, pick out, and a firm belief that every wall is a door nobody has told yet.

abilities.name: Pick-Hammer
abilities.text: {cfg:minerDamage} damage, and every swing knocks a wall down a stage: intact, cracked, gone.

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.text: Drop a timber-and-stone barricade with {cfg:barricadeHp} health. Up to {cfg:barricadeMax} at once, {cfg:barricadeLife} s each.

abilities.name: Dig and Place
abilities.text: Dig ground out and put it back where it helps: a ramp, a step, a wall.

classes.name: Demolitions Expert
classes.bio: Singed eyebrows, steady hands, and a backpack nobody stands next to. Carries no weapon. Has never needed one.

abilities.name: No Sword
abilities.text: No regular attack. The mine and the TNT are your weapons.

abilities.name: Land Mine
abilities.text: Lay a mine on your spot. It arms after {cfg:mineArm} s and blows on the first enemy who steps on it for {cfg:mineDamage} damage. Up to {cfg:mineMax} at a time; another recycles the oldest.

abilities.name: TNT
abilities.text: Throw TNT up to {cfg:tntRange} m. It blows {cfg:tntFuse} s after it lands for {cfg:tntDamage} damage, breaks walls and craters the ground.

classes.name: Builder
classes.bio: Flat cap, pencil behind the ear, ladder on his back. Give the Builder biomass and a gap, and he hands you a shortcut.

abilities.name: Ladder
abilities.text: Spend {cfg:ladderCost} biomass on a ladder up a wall of up to {cfg:ladderCells} cells, or {cfg:bridgeCost} on a rope bridge across up to {cfg:bridgeCells} cells of gap or water, toward your aim. Pieces last {cfg:pieceLife} s.

abilities.name: Carry
abilities.text: Anyone can pick a piece up with Interact and set it down somewhere else. A piece never seals a base off the hill.

abilities.name: Team Bank
abilities.text: Your team's delivered biomass pays for every piece.

classes.name: Healer
classes.bio: Armour, wings and no sword. She never lands a blow, and the hill stays yours a little longer wherever she stands.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.text: Heal the hurt ally nearest your aim within {cfg:mendRange} m for {cfg:mendHeal} health. No damage, ever.

abilities.name: Healing Wings
abilities.text: Heal every ally within {cfg:pulseRadius} m of your aim, you included, for {cfg:pulseHeal}.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Near the shrine, burn away one unit of corruption.
